propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no active readers after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its classify_probe_response function.

Both keys were operator-facing documented config with behavioral effect in shipped release v0.10.1 via adapters/jira/probe.py::_resolve_resolved_statuses and became inert only in v0.11.0, making hard removal a genuine upgrade hazard.
The keys are registered as scheduled deprecations that emit warnings but continue to parse and validate unchanged, with removal scheduled for v1.0.0.
Write-only DC plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES) was removed because nothing consumed the stored values.
Both config fields carry read-via markers pointing to follow-up ticket f408-64ad-ee41-46b6 for hard removal following the code_health.enabled precedent once operator sign-off is obtained.
